# mergewf_user_tool_access_policy (Data Source)

Reads `GET /api/v1/tool-access/users/{user_id}` from Merge Workforce. Pagination is automatic for list endpoints. API filters use snake_case attribute names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mergewf_user_tool_access_policy" "example" {
  user_id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}

output "result" {
  value = jsondecode(data.mergewf_user_tool_access_policy.example.result_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) API path parameter `user_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable hash of the request path and filters.
- `result_json` (String) API response encoded as JSON. For list endpoints this is a JSON array containing all matching results across every page. Use jsondecode to consume it. SCIM discovery endpoints retain their response envelopes.
